description:
Royal Holloway (Royal Holloway University of London) was established as a local research university in Egham, England.

The university was originally established as Bedford College in 1849. The university was renamed Holloway College in 1879 and became part of the University of London in 1900. It was renamed the present-day Royal Holloway in 1985.

Royal Holloway campus is shown as one of the most beautiful campuses in England by the authorities. The campus aims at flexibility and breadth in Royal Holloway education programs for students. While there are many educational programs that students can attend, there are also course programs for students.

Royal Holloway has also been described as top level with his research work. Royal Holloway is home to over 9,000 students. International students at the university come from over 100 different countries.

Its campus, which is built on an area of ​​135 acres, is considered one of the most beautiful campuses in the world. The university, which cooperates with government institutions, other universities and institutes for integrated research programs and technology transfer, is in partnership with private enterprises and companies within the scope of many different research projects.
